title: Process map (current state)
description: process-map/<name>.json: one swimlane current-state board. Arrays are in display order: lanes top to bottom, groups left to right, nodes group by group in flow order (an edge to an earlier node is drawn as feedback). Field meanings, the layout and every derived element are in design-system/process-map/README.md; citation rules per category are in formats/citation-types.json. Limits are layout limits: within them the board needs no third zoom level and no text is cut.

groups.description: Views: column bands of the board. Optional; with two or more, the board draws a band of group cells above the lanes.

nodes.description: A larger process is split into several maps.

sectionFile.description: A section file's name, without .json or .md. Unique in its section folder.

nodeId.description: A mnemonic of the activity, a hyphen and a number: SUB-01.

gapId.description: Its badge number is its position in gaps[].

clarificationId.description: Its badge number is its position in clarifications[].

count.description: The selectors a {count:<selector>} token in meta.subtitle may name. The build computes each value: steps and decisions count nodes by kind; the others count their arrays, leaving out a None found card.

kicker.description: Orange uppercase line above the title.

subtitle.description: Claim prose that cites nothing: its numbers come only from {count:<selector>} tokens.

client.description: The client's name as copy uses it ('Client A' in examples). Printed in the footer and the AI legend.

footer.description: Left side of the footer. Default 'Source · process map'.

role.description: Optional. What the system does in this process, in a few words: label prose checked against the system's own records. Printed by Original data received and the systems inventory, not by the board.

software.description: Optional. The product behind a system (formats/FORMATS.md section 3.1). Printed by Original data received and the systems inventory, not by the board. Named in the sources when a grounded citation's records hold the name; otherwise it carries an inferred citation (inv-1).

name.description: The product as the sources name it. Placeholder data uses Software A to Software E.

category.description: Our generic label, not a claim. One name has one category in a map (inv-1).

label.description: A role, never a person's name. Wraps to three lines in the gutter.
One line in the group cell, which may be one column wide.

title.description: The step: at most 3 lines on the card. For a decision, the question: at most 2 lines in the diamond (24 characters).

kind.description: Default step. A decision is drawn as a diamond.

group.description: Required when the map has groups.

owner.description: Optional owner line, one line on the card. Steps only.

col.description: Layout hint only: the node's column within its group, from 1. It may push a node right of its derived column, never left (map-10).

edge.description: An edge carries no citation: the nodes at its ends hold the evidence.

kind.description: Default flow. conditional leaves a decision and carries its branch label.

label.description: The branch label of a conditional edge, printed on its pill.

none.description: None found: the sources supply none, so this card, the only one of its kind, says so and cites why (grounded or inferred), and lists no step.

ask.description: What to confirm, and with whom.

order.description: This clarification asks where its steps come in the order, because no source states it. It lists only steps that no edge joins, and it excuses them from Flows (map-5); no other clarification does.

none.description: None found: the sources supply none, so this card, the only one of its kind, says so and cites why (grounded or inferred), and lists no step.
